architecture: Trams join the existing Edinburgh city as a second mode (mode: metro, catalogId prefix tram:), the Dublin Luas / Copenhagen Metro pattern. One point-to-point line (T50), 23 stops, no branches, no short-workings evidenced. NO tram hub-lock: no tram stop exists at Waverley. Three rail/tram pairs are doNotGroup (Haymarket, Edinburgh Gateway, Edinburgh Park) plus the two Edinburgh Park tram stops are kept distinct from each other.

displayPolicy: Show a countdown or predicted time only when events[].departuretime (seconds) or a pred value is present.
Never render sched as a departure time. No timetable fallback.
Event with no live value: drop it. Stop with none: 'No live predictions for this stop right now' (honest-empty-state rule, 27 Sep 2026).
pred equal to sched is NOT presented as live until flip gate G2 resolves echo vs real on-time prediction.
Zero events at a stop is not an outage signal on its own.
